_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "scientific_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "common_name" TEXT NULL, "is_builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_builtin" IN (0, 1)), "expected_pupa_days_min" INTEGER NULL, "expected_pupa_days_max" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "temperature_sensors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "external_id" TEXT NULL, "min_threshold_c" REAL NULL, "max_threshold_c" REAL NULL, "target_c" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "beetles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "species_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "sex" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "acquired_at" INTEGER NULL, "hatch_date" INTEGER NULL, "estimated_hatch_date" INTEGER NULL, "hatch_uncertainty_days" INTEGER NULL, "sensor_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES temperature_sensors (id), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "measured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_grams" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_grams" > 0.0), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "observation_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "observed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', "description" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "temperature_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sensor_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES temperature_sensors (id), "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "celsius" REAL NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "substrate_changes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "substrate_type" TEXT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "batch" TEXT NULL, "quantity_liters" REAL NULL, "beetle_weight_grams" REAL NULL, "condition" TEXT NULL, "next_planned_at" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "container_changes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "previous_volume_liters" REAL NULL, "new_volume_liters" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("new_volume_liters" > 0.0), "beetle_weight_grams" REAL NULL, "condition" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "life_stage_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "l3_phase" TEXT NULL, "is_estimated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_estimated" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photo_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "beetle_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_analyses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "question" TEXT NULL, "response" TEXT NOT NULL, "sections_json" TEXT NULL, "feedback" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'notApplicable', "outcome_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "sensor_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES temperature_sensors (id), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "basis" TEXT NULL, "severity" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "recommendation" TEXT NULL, "dedupe_key" TEXT NULL, "period_start" INTEGER NULL, "period_end" INTEGER NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NULL, "analysis_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES ai_analyses (id), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "postponed_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evidence_references" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "analysis_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES ai_analyses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reminder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES reminders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "record_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suggestion_suppressions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "beetle_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES beetles (id), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "until" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_provider_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "base_url" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "cert_sha256" TEXT NULL, "timeout_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, "consent_granted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_imports" ("backup_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "inserted_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "skipped_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("backup_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_beetles_species ON beetles (species_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_beetles_status ON beetles (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_weight_beetle_time ON weight_records (beetle_id, measured_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_observation_beetle_time ON observation_records (beetle_id, observed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_temperature_sensor_time ON temperature_records (sensor_id, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_substrate_beetle_time ON substrate_changes (beetle_id, changed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_container_beetle_time ON container_changes (beetle_id, changed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_lifestage_beetle_time ON life_stage_events (beetle_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_photo_owner ON photo_attachments (owner_type, owner_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_photo_beetle ON photo_attachments (beetle_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_analysis_beetle_time ON ai_analyses (beetle_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_reminder_status_due ON reminders (status, due_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_reminder_dedupe ON reminders (dedupe_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_reminder_beetle_event ON reminders (beetle_id, event_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_analysis ON evidence_references (analysis_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_reminder ON evidence_references (reminder_id)
